subject: Re: Quick technical demo — missed session & next-steps
body:
--- Message 1 (2026-09-28T15:22:00-07:00) ---
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightstore.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick technical demo — confirm 10/5 at 10:00am PT

Hi Elena —

Looking forward to our technical walkthrough on Monday, Oct 5 at 10:00am PT. Soojin (SE) and Marcus (PM) will join for a 30-minute session focused on:

- Architecture fit for high-concurrency checkout flows
- Token-cost and latency expectations for your 2–3k monthly customers
- Integration points (SDKs, API keys, and recommended routing)

Pre-reads attached: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf and a short integration notes file. If anything changes, feel free to update via this link: https://calendly.com/ava-chen/30min-demo

Zoom link (calendar invite): https://zoom.us/j/987654321

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--- Message 2 (2026-10-05T10:20:00-07:00) ---
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightstore.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick technical demo — missed session & next-steps

Hi Elena —

We were on the Zoom for the scheduled 10:00am PT slot but didn’t see you. No worries — things come up.

Would you like to reschedule? Below are a few windows that work for our team this week:

- Tue 10/6, 10:30–11:00am PT (SoInterpretation)
- Wed 10/7, 9:00–9:30am PT
- Wed 10/7, 2:00–2:30pm PT

If none of these fit, send a couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ll loop in Soojin and Marcus explicitly so they can confirm availability for the follow-up.

Quick recap of what we intended to cover so you can pick the right slot:
1) 10 minutes — your current flow and pain points (you)
2) 10 minutes — live demo of throughput & latency handling with sample payloads (Soojin)
3) 10 minutes — integration options and next steps (Marcus + Ava)

Cheers,
Ava

Sooj

Hi Ava —

So sorry about missing this morning — got pulled into a merchant escalations call that ran over. I appreciate the follow-up and would like to rebook. 10/6 at 10:30am PT works for me.

Would it be possible to slightly tweak the agenda to prioritize the integration checklist and data residency questions first (we’ll need answers before legal signs off)? I can send a short doc with our compliance checkbox ahead of time if that helps.

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Head of Platform, BrightStore
elena@brightstore.io | +1 (312) 555-0999

--- Message 5 (2026-10-07T15:32:00-07:00) ---
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightstore.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: 10/6 10:30am PT — updated agenda & attachments

Hi Elena —

Thanks for confirming — we have you down for Tue 10/6 at 10:30am PT (calendar invite updated). Per your ask, we’ll start with the integration checklist and data residency items first.

Updated agenda (30 min):
- 0–8 min: Integration checklist + data residency (Marcus)
- 8–18 min: Live demo of request routing, KV cache behavior, and latency profiling (Sooj)
- 18–25 min: Deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and how audit logs are surfaced (Ava + Marcus)
- 25–30 min: Next steps & immediate follow-ups (owner: Ava)

Attached: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (updated highlights slide 7) and brightstore-integration-notes.txt. If you can send the compliance checkbox doc ahead of the call, please drop it on this thread and I’ll flag it for Marcus to review before we meet.

If anything changes, I can also open a short buffer window at 11:00am PT same day in case follow-ups run long.

See you Tuesday —
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
